description_ru: Organic deposits: lichen-moss, sedge and woody peat, 1.5-3 m
Alluvial deposits: silt, sand and rounded gravel, terraced; veneer to 30 m
Nearshore marine sediments (Tyrrell Sea): silt, sand and gravel, up to 3 m; beach ridges, bars, spits
Offshore marine sediments: clayey silt, stony silt and sand, 2-7 m; probably a wave-levelled till plain
Nearshore glaciolacustrine sediments (glacial Lake Agassiz): sand and gravel ridges, beaches, bars, spits
Offshore glaciolacustrine sediments: clay, silt, sand, veneer to 20 m; iceberg scours, extensive peat
Outwash: rounded cross-stratified sand and gravel, 3-20 m
Ice-contact stratified drift: kames, eskers, moraines
Till blanket: silty to sandy, 1-10 m; drumlins, fluting, ribbed moraine
Precambrian rock: massive granitic and gneissic rock
